events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and writer, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. What's your favourite track from this legendary double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 and would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Legend Never Dies
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to inspire generations. He would have been 80.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: Innovating Sound
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly changed the game.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Beatles musician and peace activist, John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980 and would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost a true visionary. Today, we remember John Lennon, whose music and message of peace still resonate deeply. He would have been 86.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we celebrate the life and legacy of the groundbreaking artist David Bowie, who passed in 2016.

angles.name: Starman Forever
angles.copy: Forever pushing boundaries. Today, we honour David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true icon whose influence is immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, on what would have been his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today! Join us in celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, whose music still shakes the world.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the master of the riff, Jimmy Page! His contributions to rock music are simply monumental.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer-songwriter, Sir Rod Stewart, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Raise a glass! Sir Rod Stewart turns 82 today. Still got that unmistakable voice and undeniable charisma. Happy Birthday, Rod!

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Forever
angles.copy: It must be love! Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English singer Paul Young, known for his distinctive blue-eyed soul voice and 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got that incredible voice that defined a generation of 80s pop and soul.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we remember the legendary country music icon, Dolly Parton, who passed away in 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Today, we celebrate the enduring spirit of Dolly Parton on what would have been her 81st birthday. A true legend of music and philanthropy.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: The lead singer and principal songwriter of Take That, Gary Barlow, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Man Behind The Hits
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From pop anthems to solo ballads, his songwriting legacy is undeniable.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s soul and R&B hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Get outta our dreams, get into our feed! Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean. Still bringing the good times.

events.title: First Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneering artists.

angles.name: Rock History
angles.copy: Remembering the inaugural Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony from 1989. Who was in that first class, and who do you think should be next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Star Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still rocking the stage with Take That and looking as youthful as ever.

events.title: The Beatles' famous rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary impromptu rooftop concert at Apple Corps headquarters in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Roof With A View
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The acclaimed English singer, drummer, and songwriter, known for Genesis and his solo career, Phil Collins, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his solo hits, his drumming and vocals are unmistakable.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The American singer, songwriter, and actor, Justin Timberlake, celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From 'N Sync to solo superstardom, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved English actor, famous for roles like Del Boy in Only Fools and Horses and Detective Jack Frost, Sir David Jason, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true legend of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Gone Too Soon
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'. 68 years ago, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in a tragic plane crash. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter, famous for his 80s hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up', Rick Astley, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: You know the drill! Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley. What's your favourite Rickroll moment?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we honour the legendary Jamaican reggae musician Bob Marley, who passed away in 1981.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Today, we celebrate the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His message of unity and peace still resonates worldwide.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The influential American singer-songwriter, known for her solo work and numerous hits penned for other artists, Carole King, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary Carole King! A songwriting icon whose music has touched generations. What's your favourite Carole King track?

events.title: Whitney Houston would have been 64
events.blurb: On the anniversary of her passing, we remember the incredible voice and artistry of Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 years old.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Voice'. 15 years since we lost the incomparable Whitney Houston. Her music continues to inspire and move us all. She would have been 64.

events.title: Take That split up (1996)
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, millions of fans were heartbroken as British pop sensation Take That announced their split.

angles.name: Never Forget
angles.copy: 29 years ago today, pop history changed forever as Take That announced their split. Where were you when you heard the news?
